headline: Montana Regulators to Review $15.4 Billion NorthWestern-Black Hills Deal
summary: The Montana Public Service Commission is scheduled to review the proposed $15.4 billion merger between NorthWestern Energy and Black Hills Corp.
why: Regulated utility mergers require state approval and impact regional electricity distribution, grid investments, and customer utility rates.

impacts.name: NorthWestern Energy
impacts.why: Regulatory scrutiny and conditions could alter projected merger cost synergies and rate base growth.

impacts.name: Black Hills Corp
impacts.why: The outcome of the PSC review determines whether the $15.4 billion transaction can proceed to closing.
